event_name: Date 12 November 2022 Time 18:44 2022 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 November 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 32) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine
offence: Failure to follow the Race Director's instruction (point 4.1 Race Director's event notes) and alleged breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly) and team representative. The Stewards took into account that there were people on the grid just after SC Line 1, however the driver is responsible for driving the required speed during the entire lap. The Race Director's Note to Teams (document 20) specified a maximum time of 1:12.0 between the Safety Car lines and car 10 recorded a time of 1:14.185.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 10 Driving Unnecessarily Slowly
